title: Readiness Inspector: ready for what?
audience: Maintainers who need a goal-specific readiness answer without hiding missing, stale, blocked, or failed checks behind one score.
promise: Declare a goal, inspect each owner-bound predicate, preserve its evidence and state, and follow the next action.
story: A versioned release-candidate profile declares individual checks and binds them to one target revision.
A passing test and a failed dependency audit remain separate, each with its own owner, evidence, and next action.
A publish check is blocked because it would mutate external state without separate authority.
A missing profile remains unsupported instead of becoming an inferred pass, while upstream projection and stale matrices stay visible as open gates.
verified_locally: Real CLI inspect and run commands on a versioned temporary profile.
Passed, failed, blocked, and unsupported outcomes retained as individual checks.
Every recorded receipt is bound to the fixture target revision.
Source tests, lint, and package checks pass.
open_gates: Project Quality Setup and Evidence Replay receipts as owner-bound checks.
Expand stale, contradictory, and not-applicable state coverage.
Prove native follow-up navigation for failed checks.
Capture crop-safe preview, hosted no-auth case, and external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This is a local candidate packet for explainable goal-specific checks; it does not claim a complete upstream projection, hosting, or publication.
